theme.description: Premium multi-tenant SaaS for beauty salons, barbershops and aesthetic clinics in Brazil (pt-BR, R$, WhatsApp click-to-chat). Features a desktop responsive sidebar and a dedicated mobile bottom navigation bar (menu inferior) with 3 distinct architectural zones: Super Admin Back-office, Salon/Professional Operator Panel, and Public 4-Step Client Booking Wizard.

entry_surfaces./: split hero — brand value & SaaS plan preview on left, live interactive booking demo & quick switcher on right
entry_surfaces./login: branded split login — agenda & metrics showcase panel left, tenant & role credentials form right
entry_surfaces./admin: super-admin command center — SaaS MRR & subscription metrics top, salon tenant management table center
entry_surfaces./app: salon operator daily cockpit — financial summary KPIs & quick-action ribbon top, interactive daily/weekly agenda & live queue center
entry_surfaces./agendar/:slug: mobile-first 4-step consumer booking wizard — salon identity header, step progress bar, and card stage container

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete AgendaPROHair multi-tenant SaaS application in Portuguese (pt-BR) with prices formatted in BRL (R$).

Implement the 3 access views seamlessly: (1) Super Admin Master Panel with SaaS metrics & subscriber management, (2) Salon/Professional SaaS Panel with Agenda, Finance, Services & Team, (3) Public Mobile-First Booking Page (/agendar/:slug).
Include a prominent Role & Salon Switcher in the top bar to easily preview and test all 3 views (Super Admin, Salon Owner, and Client Booking).
Ensure the Desktop Sidebar is fixed on lg screens, while the Mobile Bottom Menu (Menu Inferior) appears on mobile screens (<1024px) for the salon operator.

Implement the 4-step client booking wizard with real interactive state: Service selection -> Professional selection -> Date/Time slot selection -> Client details & WhatsApp Click-to-Chat confirmation link.
Include QR Code generation using an SVG/Canvas pattern or clean visual QR display with copy URL and download/share actions.

Provide rich pre-seeded mock/database data (Studio Belleza, Barbearia Dom Pedro, Clínica Estética Glow) with realistic Brazilian appointments, services (Corte Masculino R$ 45, Escova Modeladora R$ 80, Mechas R$ 280, etc.), commission calculations, and financial charts.
Use Lucide icons, Sonner for Brazilian toasts (e.g., 'Agendamento confirmado com sucesso!'), and Recharts for monthly revenue & commission breakdown.
Attach all specified data-testid attributes to allow robust end-to-end testing.
